evidence: ResNet18 predicted 2,470 DogNose images versus approximately 2,678 from training proportions.

finding: DogMouth has the largest positive prediction shift
evidence: ResNet18 predicted 3,267 DogMouth images, +589 relative to the training-proportion reference.

finding: DogMouth is the least confident ResNet18 output class
evidence: Mean confidence was 0.849; 24.0% were below 0.80 confidence.

finding: DogNose performs strongly on labelled validation data
evidence: ResNet18 DogNose precision was 99.40% and recall was 99.57%.

finding: Increasing depth did not solve the generalisation gap
evidence: ResNet50 reduced public Kaggle accuracy from 94.63% to 93.77%.

finding: Ambiguous test images may be pushed toward DogMouth
evidence: DogMouth has both an elevated predicted count and the lowest mean confidence, but hidden labels prevent confirmation.

finding: Training and test images may differ in source or crop style
evidence: Both architectures score above 99% locally but below 95% on Kaggle, which is consistent with distribution shift.
